hl: Control knobs with an embedded red LED light line indicate if the burner is on or if there is residual heat.
Boil water quickly with a Dual-Flame Power Burner
The dual flame ring power burner has two rings for low and high flame settings so you can go from simmer to sear with ease.
The low-profile cooking surface provides a timeless, streamlined look while keeping spills contained and makes clean-up easier than ever.
A special enameling process allows the grates to be washed directly in the dishwasher instead of by hand for easier clean up.
Eliminate the guesswork of cooking with FlameSelect®
Introducing FlameSelect® on Bosch cooktops, an entirely new and better way to cook with gas. 9 preset power levels let you easily adjust flame level for more precise, controlled heating.
Simmer delicate sauces with the OptiSim® Burner
The OptiSim burner design is wider and thicker which diffuses heat evenly for better flame control when simmering delicate sauces.
